course.name: Fire Fish Ports
course.author: CaptainBeaver13
course.description:
A race to all the ports in any order. Either go around the lagoon or through, or a combination. The weather conditions possible in the Lagoon means that sailors must make dynamic decisions about the route to prevent the risks of fog or major storms that occur regularly in the area from stalling the racing.
Players can dock if they want and carry missions. 
Just enjoy the challenge.
